items.explanation: A line pointing up from the ground. Above is うえ; the on reading ジョウ appears in 上手 (じょうず, good at something).
items.mnemonic: A flag pole standing on the ground, pointing up.

items.explanation: The mirror image of 上: a line hanging down under the ground. Below is した; the on reading カ appears in 地下鉄 (ちかてつ, subway, literally underground iron).
items.mnemonic: A root hanging below the ground line.

items.explanation: A line straight through the middle of a box. Inside is なか; the on reading チュウ appears in 中国 (ちゅうごく, China).
items.mnemonic: An arrow through the middle of a target.
items.culture_note: 中国, the middle kingdom, is China, but 中国地方 is also a region of western Honshu in Japan.

items.explanation: A person stretching their arms out wide to show something big. It is read おお in おおきい (big) and ダイ in 大学 (だいがく, university).
items.mnemonic: A person with arms spread: it was this big!

items.explanation: A small hook with two little dots beside it. It is read ちい in ちいさい (small) and ショウ in 小学校 (しょうがっこう, elementary school).
Left is ひだり, as in 左手 (ひだりて, left hand). Compare with 右: both start with the same cross shape, but 左 has 工 (a tool) underneath.
items.mnemonic: The left hand holds the tool (工).

items.explanation: Right is みぎ, as in 右手 (みぎて, right hand). It looks like 左, but has 口 (mouth) underneath instead of 工.
items.mnemonic: The right hand brings food to the mouth (口).
